task: North Star screen-parity plan, task 003 (design-docs/plans/active/north_star_screen_parity/tasks/003-library-card-open-and-hover-play.md): frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail/components/ProjectCard.tsx now calls the shared ActionMenu with an `items` array (Open -> reuses the card's existing onClick(project.id) navigation; Delete -> unchanged onDelete(project.id, project.name)) instead of the legacy onDelete-only single-item mode. Added a hover-reveal play-button overlay on the cover thumbnail: on first hover the card lazily calls api.fetchProjectAudiobooks(project.id) (new call edge ProjectCard -> app/api client -> GET /api/projects/:id/audiobooks); if an assembled audiobook exists it plays via the existing global player bus (loadAndPlay/play/pause from @/store/playerBus, scope 'book') using the audiobook's `url`; if none exists the button renders disabled with title='Nothing rendered yet' rather than redirecting to Publish (adversarial-review constraint baked into the task spec). The persistent 'Details' button is unchanged (INV-1). New test file frontend/tests/unit/pages/ProjectDetail/components/ProjectCard.test.tsx (7 tests, R1 revert-checked) mocks the ActionMenu and playerBus/api boundaries per this repo's VoiceCatalogCard.test.tsx pattern.

frontend/src/pages/ProjectDetail/compone.summary: ActionMenu call switched from legacy onDelete-only mode to items=[Open, Delete]. Added hover-lazy api.fetchProjectAudiobooks(project.id) call, a centered hover-reveal play/pause overlay on the cover wired to the global playerBus (loadAndPlay/play/pause, scope 'book'), disabled with a 'Nothing rendered yet' tooltip when no assembled audiobook exists. New imports: FolderOpen/Trash2/Play/Pause icons, usePlayerBus/loadAndPlay/play/pause from @/store/playerBus, api from @/api, Audiobook type.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/ProjectDetail/.summary: New test file (mirrors src layout, none existed before): covers ActionMenu items (Open reuses onClick, Delete reuses onDelete), the hover-play overlay's disabled/tooltip state when no audiobook is assembled, loadAndPlay wiring when one exists, that clicking play never triggers card navigation, and that the Details button is unchanged.
